name: War of the Guardians
summary:
Start a miniature character avatar in a dangerous open-world forest of Blackwood Vale. Hunt masses of mobs that horde the exteriors of the safe-zone Village for loot & Currency to upgrade and defend from greater threats with hundreds of others online. 

5-Piece Modular Armor sets / 2 handed and 1 handed Weapons / Wings / Jewels & precious oils/ Trading / 4-Player Party / PVP / Free-Roam Open World / 300+ Players at once per server/ Proximity Chat/ Friends List / Mail Messages /  Safe zones with Services fro
